business_summary: Suxin Joyful Life Services Co., Ltd. provides city, property management, and value-added services for public infrastructure and facilities, commercial properties, and residential communities in the People's Republic of China. The company offers municipal infrastructure services, including sanitation cleaning, greening, construction, maintenance, regular inspection, and refurbishment services for city roads, external walls of buildings along main city roads, streetlamps, water supply network, and tram and tram platforms. It also provides property management services including cleaning, security, gardening, landscaping, repair, and maintenance services to public facilities, such as public museums, libraries, art and sports centers, city parks, and office buildings for public authorities. In addition, the company operates waste collection centers; and offers commercial property management services for industrial parks, office buildings, apartments, and commercial complexes, as well as car park space management services, resource management, property agency, and other customized services. Further, it offers residential property management and property leasing services. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Suzhou, China.
